# descope_company_azure_monitor_connector (Resource)

Manages a company-level Azure Monitor connector that streams the audit events of the whole company. It requires a company management key, and a company can have only one company-level connector.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) The client ID of the Entra application that Descope authenticates as.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) A client secret of the Entra application. Entra client secrets expire, so update this value before the secret does.
- `dcr_immutable_id` (String) The immutable ID of the OTLP-enabled data collection rule, in the form dcr-<32 hex characters>.
- `ingestion_endpoint` (String) The scheme and host of the logs ingestion endpoint, in the form https://<name>.<region>-1.ingest.monitor.azure.com, without any path.
- `name` (String) A custom name for your connector.
- `tenant_id` (String) The Microsoft Entra tenant ID of the application that Descope authenticates as.

### Optional

- `audit_enabled` (Boolean) Whether to enable streaming of audit events.
- `description` (String) A description of what your connector is used for.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the connector is disabled. This can be used to temporarily stop a connector from executing without fully deleting it.
- `mask_pii` (Boolean) Whether to mask personally identifiable information in the logs. Learn more about what is masked: https://docs.descope.com/audit-trails-and-integrations/masking-pii-in-audit-logs
- `service_name` (String) The service name attached to the logs as the `service.name` resource attribute. Default is `descope`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
